semgrep_pin_note: The version Vibe Killer v1.0.0 pins in its own CI (pip install semgrep==1.185.0). Killer pins it because the silent half of its rule-pack assertion -- the pack staying quiet on the patched fixture -- is sensitive to the engine and not only to the rules. Giver verifies by re-running that pack, so a different engine can make every static finding vanish; measured: a pipx-installed latest Semgrep reported engine.semgrep as having run and produced 0 findings on flask-vulnerable, where 1.185.0 produces 11.
